figurative_meaning_en: To start having difficulty breathing or becoming breathless
example_sentences_in_bangla: দৌড়ানোর পর তার হাঁপ ধরে গেল।
পাহাড়ে উঠতে গিয়ে হঠাৎ হাঁপ ধরে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: After running, he became out of breath.
While climbing the hill, she suddenly started gasping for air.
note: This idiom is commonly used in contexts of physical fatigue and is rooted in everyday Bengali linguistic patterns.
